note: 拼装卷。经逐单元比对，7 个单元均取自 2021 年 12 月六级听力第 1 套（其中 Recording 3 为同一讲座的后半段）。文本以线上原文为线索、以音频为准。

Conversation 1.10: To make things worse, I managed to fall right in front of four girls from the ninth grade, so I was utterly humiliated.

Conversation 2.4: I'm so excited to talk about my latest book, which was published last month.

Passage 1.4: Flashback to 1915, when a bottle of Coca-Cola cost just a nickel.
Passage 1.9: Workers at the Root Glass Company got the request and began flipping through the encyclopedia at the local library, landing on cocoa seed.
Passage 1.14: Americans mostly consume Coke out of aluminum or plastic today, but the glass bottle remains a symbol of America that's readily recognized around the world.

Recording 2.8: Rather than getting material things, children need parents' devoted attention.

Recording 1.25: The vacationer never has any reason to explore the island.
